purpose: Teach: こむ/採っ/ひざ/向く/在る/挙句/物語っ/できあがっ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、教室に駆けこむのいつもギリギリだな
lines.en: Riku, you're always cutting it to the last second before class, aren't you?
lines.style: Casual, knowing smirk. Teasing but affectionate — the tone of someone who watches and notices. Quick, light attack on the opening. No malice, just stating a pattern she enjoys pointing out.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストで満点を採ったらしいな、桜
lines.en: You got a perfect score on that test, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Slight surprise underneath. Genuine acknowledgment, almost reluctant in its sincerity. Soft, steady delivery — saying something real without making a big show of it. Brief pause before her name, like he's decided to say it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ひざを擦りむいたな
lines.en: Riku, you scraped up your knee again.
lines.style: Observation wrapped in concern. Not really a question. Dry surface tone but the words carry noticing — she's looking at the damage. Slight tilt downward on the ending, like she's shaking her head slightly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、こっちを向くといつも怖い顔だな、桜
lines.en: You always have that scary look on your face when you turn to look at me, Sakura.
lines.style: Defensive humour masking something real. Light, almost teasing delivery but there's a genuine note underneath — he's actually noticed and it actually gets to him. Pace steady, not rushed. The words sit.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家には漫画が大量に在るな
lines.en: You've got a ton of manga at your place, don't you?
lines.style: Curious, almost envious. Genuine interest — she's found something to ask about. Slight lift on the opening, like she's surprised and delighted by this discovery. Warm, not judgmental. Wanting to know more.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、議論の挙句、結局カラオケに行ったろ?桜
lines.en: After all that arguing, you ended up going to karaoke anyway, didn't you?
lines.style: Caught-you tone. Playful accusation, half-amused at how the night actually turned out. Light rhythm, almost rhythmic in the pointing-out. The word 'anyway' carries the joke. Nostalgic warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、夏休みの冒険を物語っただろ
lines.en: You told me all about your summer adventure, remember?
lines.style: Warm nostalgia. Gentle reminder of something shared. Pace slightly slower, like she's recalling the moment of him telling her. Soft on the opening, slight warmth rising through the line. Tenderness in the 'remember'.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭の準備、ようやくできあがったな、桜
lines.en: You finally finished getting ready for the culture festival, didn't you?
lines.style: Relief mixed with mild amazement. Recognition that something difficult is done. Steady, genuine praise — not over-the-top but real. The opening word carries the 'finally'. Slightly warmer close on her name, like he's pleased.
